question_en: Which charges radiate electromagnetic waves? 1) one moving uniformly in a straight line; 2) one accelerating along a straight line; 3) one oscillating harmonically; 4) one moving uniformly in a circle; 5) one at rest.
question_uz: Qaysi zaryadlar elektromagnit to'lqin nurlaydi? 1) tekis va to'g'ri chiziqli harakatlanayotgan; 2) to'g'ri chiziq bo'ylab tezlanish bilan harakatlanayotgan; 3) garmonik tebranayotgan; 4) aylana bo'ylab tekis harakatlanayotgan; 5) tinch turgan.
question_ru: Какие заряды излучают электромагнитные волны? 1) движущийся равномерно и прямолинейно; 2) движущийся с ускорением вдоль прямой; 3) гармонически колеблющийся; 4) равномерно движущийся по окружности; 5) покоящийся.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Faqat tezlanishli zaryad nurlaydi: 2 (a ≠ 0), 3 (a = −ω²x), 4 (markazga intilma tezlanish). 1 va 5 da a = 0.
Asos: nurlanish sharti.

uz: Tezlanish bor — 2, 3, 4; yo'q — 1, 5: $$a_2\neq0,\quad a_3=-\omega^2x,\quad a_4=\frac{v^2}{R},\quad a_1=a_5=0$$
ru: Ускорение есть — 2, 3, 4; нет — 1, 5: $$a_2\neq0,\quad a_3=-\omega^2x,\quad a_4=\frac{v^2}{R},\quad a_1=a_5=0$$

rules.uz: Faqat tezlanish bilan harakatlanayotgan zaryad nurlaydi: $a\neq0$
rules.ru: Излучает только заряд, движущийся с ускорением: $a\neq0$
rules.en: Only a charge moving with acceleration radiates: $a\neq0$

distractors.A: tebranish va aylanma harakatdagi tezlanish unutilgan
distractors.C: faqat tebranayotgan zaryad nurlaydi deb olingan
distractors.D: tekis harakatdagi zaryad ham nurlaydi deb olingan
distractors.E: tinch turgan zaryad ham nurlaydi deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: забыто ускорение при колебаниях и движении по окружности
distractors_ru.C: принято, что излучает только колеблющийся заряд
distractors_ru.D: принято, что излучает и равномерно движущийся заряд
distractors_ru.E: принято, что излучает и покоящийся заряд

distractors_en.A: the acceleration in oscillation and circular motion was forgotten
distractors_en.C: only the oscillating charge was taken to radiate
distractors_en.D: the uniformly moving charge was also taken to radiate
distractors_en.E: the charge at rest was also taken to radiate

question_en: How are the vectors $\vec E$, $\vec B$ and the propagation velocity $\vec v$ oriented relative to each other in an electromagnetic wave?
question_uz: Elektromagnit to'lqinda $\vec E$, $\vec B$ vektorlari va tarqalish tezligi $\vec v$ o'zaro qanday joylashgan?
question_ru: Как взаимно расположены векторы $\vec E$, $\vec B$ и скорость распространения $\vec v$ в электромагнитной волне?
options: (C) $\vec E\perp\vec B,\ \vec E\perp\vec v,\ \vec B\perp\vec v$
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Elektromagnit to'lqin ko'ndalang: E va B bir-biriga ham, tarqalish yo'nalishiga ham tik; v vektori E × B bo'ylab.
Asos: to'lqin tuzilishi.

uz: Ko'ndalang to'lqin: $$\vec E\perp\vec B\perp\vec v,\qquad \vec v\uparrow\uparrow\vec E\times\vec B$$
ru: Поперечная волна: $$\vec E\perp\vec B\perp\vec v,\qquad \vec v\uparrow\uparrow\vec E\times\vec B$$
en: Transverse wave: $$\vec E\perp\vec B\perp\vec v,\qquad \vec v\uparrow\uparrow\vec E\times\vec B$$

distractors.A: to'lqin E bo'yicha bo'ylama deb olingan
distractors.B: to'lqin B bo'yicha bo'ylama deb olingan
distractors.D: E va B parallel deb olingan — ular tik
distractors.E: E tarqalish yo'nalishiga parallel deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: E и B приняты параллельными — они перпендикулярны

distractors_en.A: the wave was taken to be longitudinal in E
distractors_en.B: the wave was taken to be longitudinal in B
distractors_en.D: E and B were taken parallel — they are perpendicular
distractors_en.E: E was taken parallel to the direction of propagation

question_en: The figure shows the vectors $\vec E$ (in the positive direction of the $z$ axis) and $\vec B$ (in the positive direction of the $x$ axis) of an electromagnetic wave in vacuum at some point. In which direction does the wave travel?
question_uz: Rasmda vakuumdagi elektromagnit to'lqinning biror nuqtadagi $\vec E$ ($z$ o'qining musbat yo'nalishida) va $\vec B$ ($x$ o'qining musbat yo'nalishida) vektorlari ko'rsatilgan. To'lqin qaysi yo'nalishda tarqaladi?
question_ru: На рисунке показаны векторы $\vec E$ (в положительном направлении оси $z$) и $\vec B$ (в положительном направлении оси $x$) электромагнитной волны в вакууме в некоторой точке. В каком направлении распространяется волна?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. v vektori E × B bo'ylab: k × i = j, ya'ni +y. Parma dastasi E dan B ga buriladi.
Asos: parma qoidasi.

uz: Vektor ko'paytma: $$\vec E\times\vec B\uparrow\uparrow\vec k\times\vec i=\vec j$$
ru: Векторное произведение: $$\vec E\times\vec B\uparrow\uparrow\vec k\times\vec i=\vec j$$
en: Cross product: $$\vec E\times\vec B\uparrow\uparrow\vec k\times\vec i=\vec j$$

distractors.C: to'lqin B bo'ylab tarqaladi deb olingan
distractors.E: to'lqin E bo'ylab tarqaladi deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: принято, что волна идёт вдоль B
distractors_ru.E: принято, что волна идёт вдоль E

distractors_en.C: the wave was taken to travel along B
distractors_en.D: the direction opposite to E was taken
distractors_en.E: the wave was taken to travel along E

question_en: A radio transmitter on a spacecraft operates at a frequency of $25\ \mathrm{MHz}$. What is the wavelength it radiates (m)?
question_uz: Kosmik kemadagi radiouzatgich $25\ \mathrm{MHz}$ chastotada ishlaydi. U nurlaydigan to'lqin uzunligi qanday (m)?
question_ru: Радиопередатчик на космическом корабле работает на частоте $25\ \mathrm{MHz}$. Какова длина излучаемой им волны (m)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. λ = c/ν = 3·10⁸/(2,5·10⁷) = 12 m. Mega — 10⁶.
Asos: λ = c/ν.

question_en: What is the speed of an electromagnetic wave in a transparent medium with relative permittivity $6.25$ ($\mu=1$) ($\mathrm{m/s}$)?
question_uz: Dielektrik singdiruvchanligi $6.25$ bo'lgan shaffof muhitda ($\mu=1$) elektromagnit to'lqin tezligi qanday ($\mathrm{m/s}$)?
question_ru: Какова скорость электромагнитной волны в прозрачной среде с диэлектрической проницаемостью $6.25$ ($\mu=1$) ($\mathrm{m/s}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. v = c/√ε = 3·10⁸/2,5 = 1,2·10⁸ m/s.
Asos: v = c/n, n = √ε.

distractors_ru.C: принято, что в среде скорость не меняется

distractors_en.C: the speed was taken not to change in a medium

question_en: An electromagnetic wave in glass has frequency $3\cdot10^{14}\ \mathrm{Hz}$ and a wavelength in the glass of $500\ \mathrm{nm}$. What is the refractive index of the glass?
question_uz: Shishada tarqalayotgan elektromagnit to'lqinning chastotasi $3\cdot10^{14}\ \mathrm{Hz}$, shishadagi to'lqin uzunligi $500\ \mathrm{nm}$. Shishaning sindirish ko'rsatkichi qanday?
question_ru: Частота электромагнитной волны, распространяющейся в стекле, $3\cdot10^{14}\ \mathrm{Hz}$, длина волны в стекле $500\ \mathrm{nm}$. Каков показатель преломления стекла?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. v = λν = 5·10⁻⁷ · 3·10¹⁴ = 1,5·10⁸ m/s; n = c/v = 2.
Asos: n = c/v.

distractors.D: nisbat ε deb olinib, ildiz chiqarilgan

distractors_ru.D: отношение принято за ε и извлечён корень

distractors_en.C: ε = n² was found instead of n
distractors_en.D: the ratio was taken as ε and the root was taken

question_en: In a plane electromagnetic wave in vacuum the amplitude of the electric field strength is $15\ \mathrm{V/m}$. What is the amplitude of the magnetic induction ($\mathrm{T}$)?
question_uz: Vakuumda tarqalayotgan yassi elektromagnit to'lqinda elektr maydon kuchlanganligining amplitudasi $15\ \mathrm{V/m}$. Magnit induksiya amplitudasi qanday ($\mathrm{T}$)?
question_ru: В плоской электромагнитной волне в вакууме амплитуда напряжённости электрического поля $15\ \mathrm{V/m}$. Какова амплитуда магнитной индукции ($\mathrm{T}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Vakuumda E = cB, demak B = E/c = 15/(3·10⁸) = 5·10⁻⁸ T.
Asos: Eₘ = cBₘ.

distractors.D: E va B son jihatdan teng deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: приняты численно равными E и B

distractors_en.A: multiplied by c instead of dividing
distractors_en.D: E and B were taken to be numerically equal

question_en: The graph shows the electric field strength versus time in an electromagnetic wave travelling in vacuum. Find the wavelength (m).
question_uz: Grafikda vakuumda tarqalayotgan elektromagnit to'lqindagi elektr maydon kuchlanganligining vaqtga bog'lanishi berilgan. To'lqin uzunligini toping (m).
question_ru: На графике дана зависимость напряжённости электрического поля от времени в электромагнитной волне, распространяющейся в вакууме. Найдите длину волны (m).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Grafikdan T = 2,5 fs = 2,5·10⁻¹⁵ s (qo'shni cho'qqilar oralig'i). λ = cT = 7,5·10⁻⁷ m.
Asos: λ = cT.

ru: Период по графику, затем длина волны: $$T=2.5\cdot10^{-15}\ \mathrm{s},\qquad \lambda=cT=7.5\cdot10^{-7}\ \mathrm{m}$$
en: Period from the graph, then the wavelength: $$T=2.5\cdot10^{-15}\ \mathrm{s},\qquad \lambda=cT=7.5\cdot10^{-7}\ \mathrm{m}$$

distractors.D: ikki davr bitta davr deb olingan

distractors_en.B: half the period was taken as the period
distractors_en.D: two periods were taken as one
distractors_en.E: the frequency was found instead of the wavelength

question_en: At a distance of $2\ \mathrm{m}$ from a point source the intensity of radiation is $36\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. What is the intensity at a distance of $6\ \mathrm{m}$ from the source ($\mathrm{W/m^2}$)?
question_uz: Nuqtaviy manbadan $2\ \mathrm{m}$ masofada nurlanish intensivligi $36\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Manbadan $6\ \mathrm{m}$ masofada intensivlik qanday ($\mathrm{W/m^2}$)?
question_ru: На расстоянии $2\ \mathrm{m}$ от точечного источника интенсивность излучения $36\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Какова интенсивность на расстоянии $6\ \mathrm{m}$ от источника ($\mathrm{W/m^2}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. I ∼ 1/r²: masofa 3 marta ortdi, intensivlik 9 marta kamaydi: 36/9 = 4 W/m².
Asos: I = P/(4πr²).

en: The intensity is inverse to the square of distance: $$I_2=I_1\frac{r_1^2}{r_2^2}=36\cdot\frac{4}{36}=4\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$$

distractors.B: intensivlik masofa bilan ortadi deb olingan
distractors.E: intensivlik r² ga proporsional deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: принято, что интенсивность растёт с расстоянием

distractors_en.B: the intensity was taken to grow with distance
distractors_en.C: divided by the square of the difference of distances
distractors_en.E: the intensity was taken to be proportional to r²

question_en: The frequency of the oscillations in a vibrator was decreased $2$ times at constant amplitude. How does the radiated power change ($\frac{P_2}{P_1}$)?
question_uz: Vibratordagi tebranishlar amplitudasi o'zgarmagan holda ularning chastotasi $2$ marta kamaytirildi. Nurlanish quvvati qanday o'zgaradi ($\frac{P_2}{P_1}$)?
question_ru: Частоту колебаний в вибраторе уменьшили в $2$ раза при неизменной амплитуде. Как изменится мощность излучения ($\frac{P_2}{P_1}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Nurlanish quvvati chastotaning to'rtinchi darajasiga proporsional: (1/2)⁴ = 1/16.
Asos: P ∼ ν⁴.

distractors.D: quvvat chastotaga teskari proporsional deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: принято, что мощность обратно пропорциональна частоте

distractors_en.D: the power was taken to be inversely proportional to frequency

question_en: The capacitance of the capacitor in the circuit of a receiver tuned to a wavelength of $150\ \mathrm{m}$ was increased $4$ times (the inductance does not change). To what wavelength is the receiver now tuned (m)?
question_uz: $150\ \mathrm{m}$ to'lqin uzunligiga sozlangan priyomnik konturidagi kondensator sig'imi $4$ marta orttirildi (induktivlik o'zgarmaydi). Priyomnik endi qanday to'lqin uzunligiga sozlangan (m)?
question_ru: Ёмкость конденсатора в контуре приёмника, настроенного на длину волны $150\ \mathrm{m}$, увеличили в $4$ раза (индуктивность не меняется). На какую длину волны теперь настроен приёмник (m)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. λ = 2πc√(LC) — λ ∼ √C: sig'im 4 marta ortsa, λ 2 marta ortadi: 300 m.
Asos: λ = 2πc√(LC).

distractors.D: to'lqin uzunligi sig'imga bog'liq emas deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: принято, что длина волны не зависит от ёмкости

distractors_en.D: the wavelength was taken not to depend on capacitance

question_en: The charge of the capacitor in a receiver circuit changes as $q=4\cdot10^{-9}\cos(1.5\cdot10^6\pi t)$ ($q$ in coulombs). What is the wavelength being received (m)?
question_uz: Priyomnik konturidagi kondensator zaryadi $q=4\cdot10^{-9}\cos(1.5\cdot10^6\pi t)$ qonun bo'yicha o'zgaradi ($q$ — kulonda). Qabul qilinayotgan to'lqin uzunligi qanday (m)?
question_ru: Заряд конденсатора в контуре приёмника меняется по закону $q=4\cdot10^{-9}\cos(1.5\cdot10^6\pi t)$ ($q$ — в кулонах). Какова длина принимаемой волны (m)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. ω = 1,5·10⁶π rad/s, ν = ω/(2π) = 7,5·10⁵ Hz; λ = c/ν = 400 m.
Asos: ν = ω/(2π), λ = c/ν.

distractors.B: siklik chastota ω chastota deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: циклическая частота ω принята за частоту
distractors_ru.E: ответ ещё раз умножен на π

distractors_en.A: the division by 2 was forgotten: ν = ω/π
distractors_en.B: the angular frequency ω was taken as the frequency
distractors_en.E: the answer was multiplied by π again

question_en: A signal sent by a radar returned from a target after $0.2\ \mathrm{ms}$. How far away is the target (km)?
question_uz: Radiolokatordan yuborilgan signal $0.2\ \mathrm{ms}$ dan keyin nishondan qaytib keldi. Nishon qanday masofada (km)?
question_ru: Сигнал, посланный радиолокатором, вернулся от цели через $0.2\ \mathrm{ms}$. На каком расстоянии цель (km)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Signal nishongacha va orqaga yo'l bosadi: d = ct/2 = 3·10⁸ · 2·10⁻⁴/2 = 3·10⁴ m = 30 km.
Asos: 2d = ct.

distractors_en.D: the time was taken as 0.02 ms (power-of-ten error)
distractors_en.E: the time was taken as 2 ms (power-of-ten error)

question_en: A radar sends $3000$ pulses per second. At what greatest distance can it observe a target (km)?
question_uz: Radiolokator sekundiga $3000$ ta impuls yuboradi. U ko'pi bilan qanday masofadagi nishonni kuzatishga mo'ljallangan (km)?
question_ru: Радиолокатор посылает $3000$ импульсов в секунду. На каком наибольшем расстоянии он может наблюдать цель (km)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Impulslar orasidagi vaqt 1/3000 s; signal shu vaqtda borib-qaytishi kerak: d = c/(2f) = 50 km.
Asos: d(max) = c/(2f).

distractors_en.C: the frequency was taken as 300 Hz (power-of-ten error)
distractors_en.E: the frequency was taken as 30000 Hz (power-of-ten error)

question_en: The capacitance of the capacitor in a receiver circuit is changed from $25\ \mathrm{pF}$ to $400\ \mathrm{pF}$, with the inductance fixed. What is the ratio of the largest to the smallest received wavelength $\frac{\lambda_{max}}{\lambda_{min}}$?
question_uz: Priyomnik konturidagi kondensator sig'imi $25\ \mathrm{pF}$ dan $400\ \mathrm{pF}$ gacha o'zgartiriladi, induktivlik o'zgarmaydi. Qabul qilinadigan eng katta va eng kichik to'lqin uzunliklari nisbati $\frac{\lambda_{max}}{\lambda_{min}}$ qanday?
question_ru: Ёмкость конденсатора в контуре приёмника меняется от $25\ \mathrm{pF}$ до $400\ \mathrm{pF}$, индуктивность не меняется. Каково отношение наибольшей и наименьшей принимаемых длин волн $\frac{\lambda_{max}}{\lambda_{min}}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. λ ∼ √C: λ(max)/λ(min) = √(400/25) = √16 = 4.
Asos: λ = 2πc√(LC).

distractors_en.C: the capacitance ratio was divided by 2
